notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26584482/3227af31c4b2cac6462eec215d72fd285dd57fca.png[/img]


[b]Attention Veterans, reports from the frontline tell of new changes and fixes to Veterans Online.[/b]


Performance:
[list]
[*] Frame rate is now capped to 120 Fps.
[/list]

Accessibility:
[list]
[*] System notification added to login screen
[*] Video tutorial added.
[*] Added shop and weapon crates UI elements.
[*] Fixed default resolution to be 1920x1080x60.
[/list]

Optimizations:
[list]
[*] Better matchmaking for quick play matches.
[*] Improved networking (fixes to disconnections and server crashes).
[/list]

Audio:
[list]
[*] Added pan override for flags, mines and Traps.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Key binding now works as intended.
[*] You can now move while checking the scoreboard.
[*] UI interaction problem when respawning while Shop is open.
[*] Reload UI not displaying when moving.
[*] Cursor interaction when respawning.
[*] Chat server fixes for better connection stability, both regional and ingame chat.
[/list]

Misc:
[list]
[*] Added 2 missing achievements description for all languages except English.
[*] Removed Case-sensitive emails.
[*] Added a feedback message when something goes wrong with the store.
[*] Added Numpad Enter input key to interact with Chat inputfield.
[/list]

notes.title: Veterans Online Release Date
notes.notes:
[b]We are excited to announce that Veterans Online is set for release on Steam on the 22nd of May 2020 at 12 PM PDT. We would like to thank our awesome community for their support and feedback during the development of Veterans Online.
[/b]

[i]You can give us one last push and wishlist the game.[/i] We hope to see you on the battlefields of Veterans Online.[img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26584482/8ab741d5db69285b6810b504b111487b52db7817.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.0.1
notes.notes:
A huge Thanks to everyone participating in the Closed Beta. 
Your feedbacks, suggestions and bug reports are highly valuable to us and will help us improve Veterans Online.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26584482/3400b3847897cce4cda48ea1b692f52a7fb8b070.jpg[/img]

In order to join the ranks of Veterans Online and claim your Steam Key, sign up to our Website at:
https://veterans-online.com/
Or Join our Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/8ub8Akd

Stay tuned for more news and updates!

notes.title: OPEN BETA Date - Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26584482/62525392479e0a413edee0ff0cf998ea006a56b5.jpg[/img]


We know we've been a bit silent about the dates for the open BETA: the reason is that we are encountering some issues with the servers' capacities (hence lags). We are working hard to solve these, and the moment we do, we will announce a date for it.

We are testing day and night, and this Sunday we will have our server's final tests. If everything goes well, you will hear from us!

Thank you for your never ending support, we really appreciate it.
Keep following us, because we have a lot of awesome news coming during the next period!

More news on our Facebook Page and Twitter.
